notes.title: Group Combos
notes.content:
Hello Brave Gatewalkers!

Adventures in Gatewalkers can be enjoyed alone or with friends. The game will be playable alone, but ... There is more strength in the group!

In previous articles, we discussed solo combos that can be cast with an epic or legendary weapon. However, there is one more way to improve your weapons: make the elemental version.

The elements not only enrich your weapons with extra strength but also allow you to perform group combos.

But… How can you do it, exactly?

You can unlock recipes for the epic/legendary/elemental version of the weapon from Tier 3 in the Progress Tree.  After buying the recipe, you have to make a new weapon! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/1c89f95bb5eaa16ab10795ee66c6f1b25422fe02.jpg[/img]

To create a weapon with an element you have to do it in the laboratory. Make sure you have all ingredients and then craft your weapon in one of the crafting stations. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/2f1db47971d2cc4d0863c29e1f2ba6164add203d.jpg[/img]

After clicking the button with your element icon in the main panel, you can read all information about your element:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/82534520286f6613687bb84546944b4c3ae79f2a.jpg[/img]

A group combo requires another player with an elemental weapon. One player must fully stack the element's effect on a mob (there will be the icon above the mob showing how many times the mob was hit). When the mob is fully stacked, another player will see an icon showing that the group combo is ready. Then, he/she has to use their ultimate skill which will automatically strike group combo. It seems to be complicated, but actually it’s very simple. Just look at the screen: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/c10e859de832899bcb40a527ea96944e3f4e8a32.jpg[/img]

Let us show you some real fun. See how powerful group combos look! 

One more thing - in most cases, there is a difference which element casts solo combo. The VFX is the same, for example for Cold + Void group combo, however there is a difference in the effect. Just look at the descriptions below:

Cold + Shock:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/1ff7a6cf2ecd23d97eb13b0e964e67d73df8a7cf.jpg[/img]
Shock consumes fully stacked Cold: Deals 3379 damage and applies stun for 2,5 sec.
Cold consumes fully stacked Shock: Deals 3379 damage and applies stun for 2,5 sec.

 Void + Toxic: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/b4273b46b6319d95e793385ae1014bb2c6358f35.jpg[/img]
Toxic consumes fully stacked Void: Deals 1877 damage, applies: damage over time effect which deals 50% damage per second, decreases target healing by 50%, and decreases resistance by 10% for 4 sec.
 Void consumes fully stacked Toxic: 1877 damage, applies: damage over time effect which deals 263 damage per second for 12 sec., decreases target healing by 50%, and decreases resistance by 10% for 4 sec.

Heat + Toxic: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/85ad5c53c14a54c87a31eb28ca8d56053c0f464e.jpg[/img]
Heat consumes fully stacked Toxic: Deals 1877 damage, applies: damage over time effect which deals 113 damage per sec for 4 sec.
Toxic consumes fully stacked Heat: Deals 1877 damage, applies: damage over time effect which deals 601 damage per sec for 4 sec.




 Shock + Heat: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/e195a93aff7ecfddc59ddeb375844d53f96f8176.jpg[/img]
Shock consumes fully stacked Heat: Deals 1877 damage, applies: interrupt, 20% daze effect, and damage over time effect which deals 469 damage per second for 4 sec. Daze decreases the movement and damage of the affected target by daze value.
Heat consumes fully stacked Shock: Deals 1877 damage, applies: interrupt, 20% daze effect, and damage over time effect which deals 469 damage per second for 4 sec. Daze decreases the movement and damage of the affected target by daze value.

 
Cold + Void:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/8026fb223d88f21eab19140aa1b9cbc701c78554.jpg[/img]
Cold consuming fully stacked Void: Deals 2253 damage, applies: 60% stack slow movement and decreases resistances of target by 2253 for 4 sec.
Void consuming fully stacked Cold: Deals 2253 damage, applies: 60% slow movement, and decreases the resistances of target by 20% for 4 sec.

What are your thoughts on solo combos? We wanted them to be effective and bring you a lot of fun. Group Combos are a fine example of why it's sometimes worthwhile to play in a group!

notes.title: Solo Combo 2
notes.content:
Hello Brave Gatewalkers!

Welcome to the second part of the solo combo article. If you haven't read the previous article - we encourage you to read it!

Briefly, the ability to unlock solo combo starts at Tier 3, when you can unlock a recipe for an epic or legendary version of the weapon. Then you are granted the possibility to forge a new, improved weapon. To use a solo combo, you have to make sure the ability is ready. The solo combo icon on the main bar will show you when the solo combo is ready to cast. One thing that is good to know - you don’t have to memorize the combination. After clicking the solo combo button, the combination will be shown on the screen all the time:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/0932a2ef1f3213430e96f1bbe321c455683b8e6f.jpg[/img]

Then you have to fight using the correct sequence of skills, and the solo combo will appear automatically:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/b7b23b0acbb5af9dec3e138c7383c98f2757dfc6.png[/img]

Epic/Legendary weapons are game-changers for Gatewalkers. Solo combos have completely different, much more powerful abilities than the usual player abilities. They deal a lot of damage to enemies within a wide range, and many more! Some solo combos focus on damage, some on restoring shield, every weapon deals different bonuses, etc. It is worth knowing the capabilities of each weapon in advance and choosing the one that suits your tactics. Both epic and legendary versions of a given weapon share the same solo combo, but the legendary version is stronger.

Below are examples of solo combos with descriptions. 


Warhammer (Stunning Aura - Four bursts of energy striking 2 sec. Apart. Each burst deals 777 damage to all enemies in a 7m radius and stuns all enemies for 0,5 sec.)

[img]http://i.imgur.com/7smpXte.gif[/img]


Dual Dagger  (Ultimate Toxin - Throw with a dagger that poisons enemies dealing 1026 damage per second for 4 sec.)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/51NtJla.gif[/img]


Qubic (Orbital Strike - Every 2 sec. For 4 sec. shoots a laser within a 10 m. radius from the player. Each meteor creates AOE that deals 800 damage in a 2 m. radius)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BdChYBo.gif[/img]


Light Energy Catalyst (Pillar of Light - All allies in a 7m. radius get 25% shield restoration per second, the effect lasts 5 sec.)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/A3zN0ZC.gif[/img]


Great Sword (Etheral Guardians - Every ally within 10 m. range summons 2 energy orbs that will continue to orbit around them for 6 sec. Orbs grant 50% to movement speed. Contact with the enemy dissipates the orb’s energy dealing 1166 damage to the target and restoring the owner’s shield by 442)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/takywDg.gif[/img]


Great Hammer (Sky Rage -  Meteor rain every second for 4 sec. 3 meteors fall within the radius of 10 m. from the player. Each meteor creates AOE which deals 700 damage in a 2 m. radius)

[img]http://i.imgur.com/rquGekM.gif[/img]

Dark Catalyst (Pillar of Darkness - All allies on 7m m. radius get +20% damage dealt bonus for 5 sec)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oMb1jKl.gif[/img]

Battle Axe (Predecessor Axe - Summons the predecessor axe which spins in a 2 m. range around the player. It deals 1366 damage per second and lasts for 10 seconds)

[img]http://i.imgur.com/U4WeUHb.gif[/img]


Note: The figures provided are examples only. The range and/or damage value can increase with the higher tier of the weapon.

What do you think about the weapons and their solo combos? We tried to make them unique, but also effective! Which weapon would you like to try the most?

notes.title: Solo Combo
notes.content:
Hello Brave Gatewalkers!

This article will show you something that excites every Gatewalker - solo combos!

They are not only exciting and effective but also deal a lot of damage and can help you to win every fight faster! That’s why a lot of Gatewalkers make this a priority in their fighting tactic.

So how can you actually do a solo combo? From Tier 3 you have the possibility to buy epic or legendary versions of every weapon (you can buy them in any sequence you want).

Epic weapons and Legendary weapons deal more damage than basic weapons. Legendary weapons are stronger than Epic weapons.

If you have an Epic or Legendary weapon you gain the possibility to cast a solo combo. Every weapon has a different solo combo. You can induce a solo combo by doing a mouse/keyboard (or pad) combination as shown below.

Solo combos are powerful - they have a big range and deal a lot of damage. Every weapon has a different combo, so it’s good to know them beforehand. Let us show you what they look like!


Force Staff (Rotating Beam combo - shoots a beam that rotates around the player. Deals 537 damage per second, 6m long, and lasts for 6 seconds)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yw8mfUE.gif[/img]


Spell Sword (Sonic Wave combo - shoots a sonic wave around the player. Deals 2189 damage in a 7m radius. Affected targets are stunned for 1 sec.)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6TCFjaG.gif[/img]



Rifle (Volley combo - shoots bullets around in a radius of 5 m. Deals 5433 damage and stuns targets for 2 sec.)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CQS5bGz.gif[/img]


Grenade Launcher (Shrapnel Shot combo - deals 3188 damage to all enemies in 7m in front of the player)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/h6VcQHv.gif[/img]


Broadsword (Parry Strike combo - creates a barrier ready to absorb up to 1995 damage and explodes after 4 sec. The explosion deals 1104 damage in 4m radius. The damage of explosion scales with the damage absorbed by the barrier; an explosion from a depleted barrier will have 100% increased damage)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gT8pYr5.gif[/img]


Bow (Ghost Arrow combo - fires a series of spiritual arrows in all directions every 1s for 5 s. Shoots 554 damage to everyone in 5m radius)

Attention: Damage points given above are just an example - they are increasing with the higher tier of weapons.

notes.title: Combat in Different Worlds
notes.content:
Hello Brave Gatewalkers!

Playing the ARPG game is not only about winning the fight or achieving the highest rank - it's more about the process and fun you have during different adventures. The satisfaction coming from the realization of your goal with your own skills is priceless. 

That's why, in Gatewalkers, you can explore different dimensions. This way, players won't get bored with repeatability and must adapt to new surroundings. Every world brings new challenges - combat and survival in each require a different tactic. Let's sum up the most critical challenges of fighting in various worlds:

Forest World
[img]https://i.imgur.com/mHEc8Te.gif[/img]

“The night came, and it was so dense that I couldn't even see my hand. I wanted to make a fire quickly, but before I could get a branch… It showed up. A Nightmare. A huge black mass. Legs, lots of legs, but also claws... The fear took me completely. I began chaotically swinging the hammer, but it felt like I was hitting the air.”

Forest World is the first you will explore in the game. Also, it will be probably the world you will visit more frequently. Why? Because it's full of resources. Wood, stones, animals, mushrooms and berries, different herbs, and clean water are essentials you need to survive. It seems to be a pretty pleasant place to be. However, it's full of various creatures - and I am not talking only about the monkeybats! Hyenas, giant deers, Surian camps… Another challenge is a deep night. If the player gets lost in madness, her/his subconscious will spawn nightmare creatures!



Ice World
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MILPkhw.gif[/img]

“Dangers lurk around here somewhere. I have met one huge animal already. It resembled a polar bear but was much more aggressive and had terrifying fangs. Luckily I took the best weapon with me.”

Ice world has many deeps and plateaus, and it's impossible to get through any of them since they're unimaginably vast. To survive, players should craft warm clothes, eat adequate food, and use heat sources, like campfires, to warm themselves. Blizzards are one of the hazardous features of the Ice world. Another one? Giant wild animals. They have one plus, though - you can use some of their meat or fur after killing them. 
But don't think they are the only inhabitants of the Ice World! Some Surian tribes seem to be visiting the place. They abandoned the traditional Surian look and have been seen wearing warm furry coats. Moreover, they have developed unique powers, and some Gatewalkers saw them extracting energy from ice and coldness... What are they planning to do?!


Toxic World
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KI3A6Kd.gif[/img]

“ Before I could think, they pounced on me. They beat me up badly, but I managed to kill them. However, struggling for life also used up all the air. I began to choke. I stumbled, unable to catch my breath...”

When it comes to the toxic world, it is very challenging. The air is contaminated, making breathing almost impossible without proper equipment. There is no food or water. The terrain is mountainous; The top is a safe spot, but the lower you travel, the more dangerous it becomes. Dangerous creatures are hiding deep in the Toxic world undergrounds... They hide in caves where the air is less toxic, poison anyone who dares to enter their home, and then feed on opponents' bodies.


Sky Rocks
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FsEwUhW.gif[/img]

“A huge creature resembling a bird appeared in front of us. Wings, sharp claws, furious eyes. And after we finished fighting it, I felt something strange. My hair started to rise and my body shuddered. I felt as if I was drawing some unknown force towards me.”

Sky Rocks is the place that young Gatewalkers visit only after receiving proper training. Why? Because at first, it seems like a weird (for some even charming) but not so difficult place and they lower their guard. Who would be scared of large mushrooms and broken windmills anyway? However, the planet is quite tricky. Dense fog makes it difficult to navigate. The space is filled with energy, and the streaks of lightning are induced to get rid of it. During exploration, dynamic actions (such as combat) cause electrical charges to accumulate in living organisms. A deadly electrostatic discharge may occur if that electrical charge surpasses a critical level! It is also a home for Volarians, a winged humanoid race capable of thriving in the skies. They don't like to be disturbed…


Fire World
[img]https://i.imgur.com/roXV4eJ.gif[/img]

“And then a vast creature that looked like a magma ball jumped out of the crater. I thought it might be an anomaly, but no... It was Fire Lavu. He grabbed one of ours and dragged him into the lava. He died right away, engulfed in liquid fire. Our screams alerted the Fireborns, who started running towards us, thinking we were preparing to attack.”

Fire World is a harsh and unfriendly location where Gatewalkers will face extreme temperatures and dangerous anomalies - fire tornados, geysers, and meteors! There is also no food or water, so it makes it very difficult to explore.
This dangerous environment led to the evolution of very mysterious creatures. In the heart of Fire World, you can find, for example, bizarre humanoids - Fireborns. Also, perilous beings like Fire Lavu jump out of the lava and attack unsuspecting victims. But don't think that they are the only ones! The fire world hides a lot of different creatures… At least we think so since Gatewalkers who return to the Guild after missions in Fire World are too exhausted to talk.




What World is the most interesting to you? And why? 

BTW all the quoted fragments are from a short series “The Journal of the Nameless Gatewalker” which you can read on our Instagram page!

notes.title: MEET THE CHARACTERS #7 - FRITZ WAGNER
notes.content:
Dear Gatewalkers!

Today we will tell you more about a character that you meet in Gatewalkers - Fritz Wagner. 

Fritz calls himself the “Robe Enchanter” and you can almost always find him near the loom when he creates materials for robes and coats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/607db1584fc8f1db5163e9bdd1c7ae68ab98d180.jpg[/img]

Fritz was an orphan taken in by a theater troupe. They tried to train him so that when he grew up, he would become an excellent actor and thereby provide the troupe with a prosperous life. Unfortunately, Fritz proved to be completely non-talented when it comes to acting. However, the troupe discovered other skills that were equally valuable to the theater. Fritz created brilliant clothes, costumes, and robes. They delighted with their appearance, charming the audience, providing admiration, and filling the group's panniers with gold. News of their successes spread throughout the entire Bastion, until it finally reached the Guild. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/954b248adb959ad24426760d5d992d2ff5237c08.jpg[/img]

Guildmaster, interested in it, invited the troupe to perform and was enchanted by it. She noticed Fritz's talent and told him to stay in the Guild to make costumes made of material saturated with the essence of the ancients. The process turned out to be extremely difficult, but Fritz's experience and talent bore fruit, giving another powerful outfit in the guild's arsenal. 

Fritz himself is quite eccentric, his theatrical upbringing saturated him with a creative mind, but the manner of his expression seems to be too much for the others. Fritz is happy to sew and create, but he often thinks back to his childhood spent in the theater, missing traveling and joking around. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/9bf7c0bc3a692e68fbae7cb7b194faafbec2ee21.jpg[/img]

He is a good friend of Loulou Dupont, as she is an artistic person too. They can spend hours designing, talking about art, or doing improvisations. He deeply values Bernard Treth for his skills and weirdly enough, they became close. He also became in great relationships with Talah Kinith, the Guildmaster, admiring her strength and good taste in wine and style. Still, his carefree attitude made him enemies too - Viktor Hemming, Louis Mccarthy, Ursulina Tragar, and Elana Kovnic can’t find a common ground with him at all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/3693efbcecd7b7ea20be89d3427382d4ea5b0c6e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: MEET THE CHARACTERS #8 - MARTHA ODELL
notes.content:
Dear Gatewalkers!

Today we will tell you more about a character that you meet in Gatewalkers - the huntress, Martha.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/926d397c030099189f14524fc18dff31d7f47427.jpg[/img]

Martha was born in one of the dilapidated, abandoned villages. Her mother died of a mysterious disease a few days after giving birth. Her father took her and after weeks of traveling, they managed to sneak into the City where they settled down.

Martha was sick a lot as a child. She believed that she was only a burden and a worry for her father, who spent every coin on medications. After discovering who the Gatewalkers were, she wanted to become one herself. Her father was against it. Martha thought that he could change his mind if she had more strength. So, she joined him on his hunting trips and spent the following years hunting animals, climbing trees, throwing knives, and shooting arrows. However, heavy exercise aggravated her disease. One day, while fighting a boar, Martha passed out and almost died. The local doctor was useless. The only hope was a scientist living in the Guild.

Victor took care of Martha and cured her with the appropriate doses of toxic plants. After six months of intensive treatment, she recovered almost completely. Victor suspected that severe side effects could appear in the future, but he kept it a secret.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/916af4093cfd05648c89a9a4b30b1d02f593a3cf.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/babe3f11f12914f3512f84506f9641c483b32bdd.jpg[/img]

Martha knew this was her chance to become someone important. She convinced her father to stay in the Guild by saying that she had to pay off her debt. A few days later, she started her training.

Now, she is an excellent huntress. She is mainly involved in hunting and gralloching animals. It makes her happy. 

She is friendly with everyone in the Guild but prefers to spend time alone. She loves to practice the art of hunting, reading or visiting her father. There is only one person in the Guild, who makes her angry. It’s Loulou Dupont - also a great huntress. She thinks Loulou is constantly bragging about her skills, but in reality, Loulou wants to impress her... Or maybe even charm her.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/4a37e67d21dcd89752d3d575a7d3db76438ccd9d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Progress Tree - an explanation (part 2)
notes.content:
Dear Gatewalkers! 

Last week we showed you what our progress tree looks like. We would like to explore what the structure looks like and how you can upgrade your weapons!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/9b60929e40bb1d253c3d62b28f38d3a21d3ec031.jpg[/img]

The rules are simple:
[list]
[*]You start the game with Tier 1. If you upgrade to Tier 2, you can buy things from T1 and T2, but not T3. 
[*] We don’t have a classical “level up” mechanism. To upgrade you need to collect progress points, and then with an appropriate number of points, you can unlock a higher Tier. 
[*] You have to collect progress points to unlock recipes for weapons, armor, etc. What’s more, another player cannot give you a piece of better equipment if you don’t have an unlocked recipe for it, because you won’t be able to use it.
[*] You are rewarded with progress points for completing quests and objectives. Also, you can look for ancient technology fragments. You will find them during your exploration of other Worlds. Then you need to give them to Victor in the laboratory, and he will reward you with progress points.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/c1a3de866ffa872b2b95daf7b22b88c868598c54.jpg[/img]

[*] From Tier 3 you have the possibility to buy epic or legendary versions of every weapon, as well as elements. You can buy them in any sequence you want. Experienced Gatewalkers can gain a lot using them! But bear in mind that you are unlocking recipes for epic/legendary/elements only, so after buying you have to make a new weapon!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/70ec74ee891a31ef319de206123b5e1db6a93f68.jpg[/img]

[*] To create a weapon with an element you have to do it in the laboratory.Make sure you have all ingredients and then craft your weapon in one of the crafting stations. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/de858545f1555a6c82edce09111d1faa9f943450.jpg[/img]

[*] Epic weapons and Legendary weapons deal more damage than basic weapons. Legendary weapons are stronger than epic weapons.

[*] If you have an epic or legendary weapon you gain the possibility to cast a solo combo. Every weapon has a different solo combo. You can induce a solo combo by doing a mouse/keyboard (or pad) combination:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/2b83f58ebabb02983a6591780cd94a9ed52ce66e.jpg[/img]

[*] After enchanting your weapon with an element you will gain the possibility of a group combo. You can read all information about your element after clicking the button with your element icon in the main panel:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/d338f73142443387b3f064b7f33a89189ac23002.jpg[/img]

[*] To do a group combo you need another player, who also has a weapon with an element. One player needs to stack the element’s effect on a mob fully, and then another player will see an icon above the mob - at this moment the second player has to use their weapon, and the group combo strikes! Here is an example of a Cold/Shock combo:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/01c6ed993c52d7cae846b7e88ddbcdda9c5599ae.jpg[/img]
[/list]


Here is an example of Staff progression - from Tier 1 to Tier 3 Legendary Staff with Heat element:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/728c629fdd887187367efdfb9f948bdb8b5b0600.jpg[/img]

We will tell you (and show you!) more about solo and group combos in upcoming articles.

We hope you liked today’s post. What do you think about progressing weapons in Gatewalkers?

notes.title: Progress Tree - an explanation
notes.content:
Dear Gatewalkers! 

Today we are going to show you what our progress tree looks like. 

If you played the demo you probably saw it, but you might have felt a bit lost because it’s quite vast! So, here is an easy explanation of all of the branches, so when you play you know exactly where to look for anything you want!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/4010d6fdb12e3665b3837d486925f411584b5b4a.jpg[/img]

As you can see, the left side of the progress tree is all about weapons. 

The right side is about equipment. The map is divided in two colors there - blue one is the clothes/armor part, and in the red triangle you can find rings and amulets as well as survival equipment (pickaxe, knife etc). 

So now let’s focus on the weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/87e78f712d906dfb4d50646cd9d24e44fe61cb05.jpg[/img]

We divided the tree in three parts here - based on one basic three weapons. So, Force Staff T1 starts the magic weapons part, Warhammer T1 starts heavy weapons and Bow T1 divides into all kinds of bows, but also dual dagger, rifle, pistol and handgun! 

So, for example if you are looking for a long sword, check out the branches starting from “warhammer”. But, if you want a spellsword or qubic, look in the magic area. Everything connected with magic is in one place. 

Today we just gave an introduction, and in a week we will present exactly how the character progression system works, so stay frosty!

notes.title: MEET THE CHARACTERS #6 - LOUIS MCCARTHY
notes.content:
Dear Gatewalkers!

Today we will tell you more about a character that you meet in Gatewalkers - Louis McCarthy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/2f7a05ecd19ca1a8eaca0aef392ba904e6aec945.jpg[/img]

The player meets Louis as a Chef of the Guild. 

Louis used to be an active Gatewalker, known for his bravery. He served in one ward along with Markus Henrid in the years when both of them had just finished training. They both showed great battle skills and to this day older Gatewalkers are debating, if Louis hadn’t been wounded during one of the missions, would he be the warden of the Gate, instead of Markus? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/84daad9a04ef7f387384b0a14ed96147906039ea.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/45b444d716c93b11921152297ea9d6fe58ee48d5.jpg[/img]

Louis was released from service as a result of many injuries received during a mission to capture a horrible monster in the Ice world. It was not captured and in addition, took Louis' eye as a souvenir. The man did not want to give up his service, but in such a state he could no longer perform the tasks. The Guildmaster also did not want to expel the old friend from the Guild and let him stay.

Louis devoted himself to his second passion - cooking. Since that day, good-natured Louis has been trying to take care of every guild member, preparing wonderful dishes from products supplied by his companions, brought from different worlds. Louis has gained weight in the last years in the canteen, but don't let his appearance fool you. This giant can still defend himself and others!

He is good friends with Markus Henrid, Talah Kinith, Elana Kovnic, and Loulou Dupont. He doesn’t really like Viktor Hemming because he doesn’t understand a thing of his doings, Fritz Wagner (Louis called him “nothing but a dandy” which made Fritz so angry, that they don’t speak until this day) and Taiho Everdine, who for him is an aggressive brat.

notes.title: Sky Rocks
notes.content:
Dear Gatewalkers!

Today we will share with you more information about one of the worlds you will explore during your play. This place is called “Sky Rocks” and it is a bit different than the worlds you have already explored. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/82f5f972f55d43a7cc466f275f5215e4d9d62489.jpg[/img]

The biggest difference is terrain - the mountains are in fact a complex of giant rocks, hanging in the air above the clouds. So, you can explore the land only by using drawbridges. The place creates a specific atmosphere - the space is filled with energy and to get rid of it, the streaks of lightning are induced. Also, you will face different creatures - giant raptors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/4764ce43fc49a03a1d91d43010ebd9599a7f3afd.jpg[/img]

While walking around the world, players collect the charge. When the player collects 100% of the charge, he is struck by lightning. Lightning brings a large AOE dealing damage - 33% of max shield and destroys durability of all worn items by 10% (including perk).

To get rid of the charge, the player can stay close to the earthing devices that are already existing in the world (e.g. in ancient buildings), build an earthing device or enter a cave. In the cave, the charge slowly diminishes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/3a900873d09dd87633a13a100938409201392fd3.jpg[/img]

If the player has 80% or more charge, the earthing device will take the charge from the player and take the discharge on itself.
If a player with a load greater than 90% is near the earthing device, he loses the charge and the earthing device starts to charge the AOE with lightning and after a small delay the lightning strikes the earthing device. Everyone in range takes damage.

I hope you liked this post! If you wish to talk or have any questions, don’t hesitate to contact us! 

Best,

notes.title: MEET THE CHARACTERS #5 - URSULINA TRAGAR
notes.content:
Dear Gatewalkers!

Today we will tell you more about a character that you meet in Gatewalkers - the librarian, Ursulina Tragar.

There is no older and wiser person in the Guild than Ursulina. Her knowledge is widely used. You can find her in a library - she basically lives there. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/168f18ac602dd827ecda9f8aae92c30faf55d82d.jpg[/img]

The Guildmaster often goes to her for advice on many matters. Ursulina also teaches general knowledge to young adepts. She loves the Guild and the library and takes care of precious books. Despite the general respect that every member of the Guild has for Ursulina, many Gatewalkers think she is a weirdo because of her beliefs. Ursulina thinks that many notes and materials prove that the cataclysm will come soon and destroy everything. She says that the world is dying cyclically to cleanse itself of the plague that fills it with the essence. Such a filled world is saturated with energy and is slowly being destroyed. The perpetrators of the plague die with the world, and the disease-free world blooms again and creates life. Ursulina believes that we should let the world die, not try to save it with an essence that can forever destroy it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/d57d9f717822dfccada06827097c66f4e1549f88.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/a1ba63777ebc7810b65a8651fe4586390bc90bbd.jpg[/img]

She is a quiet person who doesn’t get involved with other people’s businesses. She is only close with Victor Hemming, and Arvin Gabnis - the Swordmaster of the Guild. However, for some reason, she is mean towards Loulou Dupont, the huntress, and light armor master. No one knows what happened between them, but Ursulina is not keen on talking about that. Theodor Seed, the prophet, also makes her angry. Well, maybe he just has another opinion about the cataclysm? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/168f75b3195d66a498acf7f08d65bed69bcd53f1.jpg[/img]

Today we share with you more info about another character you met during the Demo - Victor Hemming!

Victor is constantly seeking answers about the nature of the world in which we live. That’s why he became Guild’s Master Academic. 

From an early age, he was fixated with artifacts of the ancients. He studied every material he could find. He was the most talented student of Ursulina Tragar, who believed that Victor may be the first one to figure out all of the Ancient’s secrets. He was a very smart person indeed, but his obsession led him to dangerous experiments. His strive to find out the truth made him the most eminent scholar in the Guild but also marked him with diseases that entail too long exposure to the ancient essence. The essence damaged his skin, hair, eyes… It is slowly killing him, but the irony is, that he feels alive only when exposed to it. 

The growing pressure to discover the truth, the essence, solitary life… Victor became a little insane. He is a person who is very hard to cope with. His strange ways and coldness towards people are what make him the most disliked person in the entire Guild. The only friend he has is his old teacher, Ursulina. The rest tries to avoid him at all costs.

notes.title: GATHERING RESOURCES
notes.content:
Hello Gatewalkers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/4af5b0f5c23b3437c3eb725361a86cf0683e63c5.jpg[/img]

Today, we'll briefly introduce you to another aspect of the game - gathering resources. 

In Gatewalkers we diversify the collection of raw materials with an additional aspect, which is an uncommon and rare collection.

Breakdown of raw materials:
common - raw materials commonly available. Additionally, these resources can be tier and can be processed in crafting stations. Usually, common tier resources are processed into a processed version and only then we craft the target items from them (the exception is tier 1). This is the basis for most crafting recipes.

Examples: Fiber, Wood, Ore, Hide
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/42859c0d8d9707c71d847be528f3d38b2ce33bed.jpg[/img]

uncommon - resources that drop from nodes of common resources, but usually only have some chance of falling while mining. The chance of dropping depends on the level of the tool you use. These are the resources that will be rather used for T3 + weapons (other recipes also, e.g. rings, will require silver or gold)

Examples: sulfur, silicon, silver, gold, resin, seeds.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/2edfb0e3f6fd75f8e1a3cd2660b792454c24435d.jpg[/img]

rare - resources that have their own name and do not have tiers. They have their representation in the world and are hard to  find.

Examples: starstone, moonlight flower.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/b4c1dadd8e7c7ba727a6b8dc64418197f9b272ff.jpg[/img]


At the time of extracting resources, it is checked with what tools we have extracted. Example of operation: We extract IronOre using PickAxe. Over time, the tools wear out and new ones have to be made.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/dc8d2d3f337ef1659f8d2bf22a995b8fd4657aa5.jpg[/img]

Remember that every world has different resources, so during your quests take a few minutes to gather them! And also keep in mind to have some extra wood to create new tools.


Best,
Gatewalkers Dev Team

notes.title: Elite monsters
notes.content:
Hello Gatewalkers!

Today we will tell you about elite monsters. Who are they and where can you find them?

Elite monsters protect the treasure chests. There are different types of monsters in the game that you will have to face, but they all have common features.

You can face elite monster groups in the game. They always consist of 1 champion and 2-7 henchmen. Majority of monsters you’ll meet in the game are elite. They have different skills. 

Each time you fight, there may be different combinations of elites and skills they have.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/8b139266cae9724db6b8aa5dd047779fceb1d456.jpg[/img]

The champions have both major and minor buffs, and his HP is at 500%. Henchmen however, have only a minor buff, the same one as his champion, and have 150% HP.

So the greatest difficulty is the champion. Champions have different abilities. For example, the major buffs list includes:
[list]
[*] BOMBER - a small spark spawns around the mob from time to time. You can destroy it within 7 seconds, e.g. 3x with any attack. If the time is up, the spark will explode causing AOE damage. 
[*] DEATH RAY - a small spark spawns around the mob from time to time. You can destroy it within 7 seconds, e.g. 3x with any attack. If the time is up, an orb is spawned from which a radius is channeled that rotates and deals damage.
[*] DEFENDER - Champion gives a 50% resist buff to his companions, but not to himself.
[*] SELF-IGNITION - every 10-20 seconds there is a fiery AOE explosion around the champion,  however it blocks champion movement for a moment. 
[/list]


When it comes to minor buffs, there are:
[list]
[*] VENGEANCE - When dying, gives all mobs with “Vengeance” effect a major buff for defense and damage.
[*] HEALER - When the champion dies, he heals all mobs in the area.
[*] TELEPORTER- Mob teleports near its target every 15 seconds.
[*] ESCAPIST - Every 10-15 seconds mob teleports away from enemies.
[*] TRAIL - Mob leaves a trail of AOE 60 damage per second.
[/list]

notes.title: MEET THE CHARACTERS #2 - MARKUS HENRID
notes.content:
Dear Gatewalkers!

Today we will tell you more about a character that you meet in Gatewalkers. Last time we wrote about Elana, and today another brave Gatewalker - Markus Henrid. 

You are probably familiar with him already! You met him in the Guild a few times during the demo. But who is he, actually? His function in the Guild is very important - Markus is a Gate Guard. His duty is to make sure that no unauthorized person crosses the gate, and that no monster gets to the Guild.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/bf1ed8762bc51f18434b9db5c5f48816234e975b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/444e3f954ca6a5a6eb9935a6d7f5db4dd89241fd.jpg[/img]

Markus lost his parents at a young age. Guild saved him and his sister when they were kids, and trained them to become Gatewalkers. Markus was taller and stronger than others at his age, and that’s why he completed his training very fast. When he joined regular missions, everyone valued him not only because of his strength, but because he was a quick thinker and always made good decisions. A few years later his sister joined him, and although she had a sharp mind, she lacked a physical flair. Markus always took care of his little sister and having in mind her security, he became even more cautious while planning a strike. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/e56549de4810c311e8c35038cc76b859cf8a64d1.jpg[/img]

Markus showed the highest physical strength and prudence in making decisions on the battlefield as Gatewalker. After many victories, he received the title of best Guild warrior and the honor of exercising care over the portal. He wasn’t delighted with the new role - he preferred to be a simple soldier. He never wanted fame or glory. He was also worried about his sister.  Unfortunately, the sense of duty and loyalty to the Guild does not allow him to leave the post.

Markus has a positive attitude to life. He likes to joke around with other soldiers and have a good meal. He believes that every person has their own mission in life, and that’s why he doesn’t criticize others. That’s probably the reason why he doesn’t have any enemies in the Guild. His closest friends are his sister, Elana Kovnic, Louis Mccarthy, Bernard Treth, and Arvin Gabnis. He doesn't seem to like Taiho Everdine, Viktor Hemming, and Talah Kinith, but he shows them respect and never talks bad about them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/141c16f95b4eda0b28560d0efcaaa62d150975be.png[/img]

notes.title: Gem Acquisition
notes.content:
Hello Gatewalkers!

Today, we'll briefly introduce you to another aspect of the game - gem acquisition!
Gemstones are essential for making rings and amulets. It is true that you don't need jewelry to complete the game - but having it will be helpful for you!

Basic versions of rings and amulets are made using anvil:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/d6be9fde6fe019a012e6ef03a9529827e16cde46.jpg[/img]

However, you can enhance them with elements in laboratory:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/e8132e1f478657fdd8f84abbe9a15fca2db743a9.jpg[/img]

But how to get precious stones? The only place to acquire them is the Fire world. A gemstone is a resource that can be mined with a pickaxe.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/26516c85c0cf8838641b86d17f000b7c037d397d.jpg[/img]


You can wear two rings and one amulet at the same time, so wearing all three can boost your powers significantly.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/af6f2089832d88c2aa5b10698a79b7de4d460e54.jpg[/img]

PS. See the merchant over there? Gems are precious, so even if you have the jewelry you desire it’s good to gather them and buy something from a merchant, for example an extra tent. Or if you are lucky and found a lot of gems… just make a piece of beautiful jewelry and give it to your friend - that’s a gift every Gatewalker will love!

Best,

notes.title: MEET THE CHARACTERS #1 - ELANA KOVNIC
notes.content:
Dear Gatewalkers!

We want to start a short series about characters that you meet in Gatewalkers. Our NPCs have their own stories. You have already met some of them in the Guild during the demo. Now there is time to share a little bit more about them. 

The first person you meet when starting the game is Elana Kovnic. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/d78d42a4aafac4479e8ea986579d7bd220afc894.jpg[/img]

Elana is an experienced Gatewalker. She became a professional Gatewalker two years before you joined the Guild and took part in many dangerous expeditions. She is young, however so talented, that she quickly became an important person and started to train new students. 

Elana's great results come from many years of training that she began undergoing as a child. Her parents set high standards for her and she started training in her early years. Ragged from her childhood, Elana grew into a woman who would not dare to question the Guild's decisions and would obey every command, desperate to impress her parents with her achievements. 

Despite her results and outstanding attitude, Elana belongs to very trusting people, maybe even too naive. She follows the rules and is very loyal. You may think that her parents forced her into this lifestyle - it is true, however, Elana fell in love in a fight. She loves challenges and preparations. She always keeps her armor clean and her weapons sharp. Her tongue is sharp too - she hates sugarcoating! She will always tell others what she thinks. That’s why a lot of rookies think she is bossy. In reality, she deeply cares about students and wants to prepare them for everything. 

She has a lot of friends*: Markus Henrid, Talah Kinith, Taiho Everdine, Louis Mccarthy. She is Arvin Gabnis's favorite. But there are some people that she hates. Among them are Viktor Hemming, Theodor Seed, Loulou Dupont, and Fritz Wagner.

notes.title: Gatewalkers Weaponry #5 GreatSword
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/c61975216efb66bfac8f68e7dd308970e829470c.jpg[/img]

Dear Gatewalkers!

Today, we will discuss one of the RPG classics - the Greatsword. Greatswords seem like an easy weapon to use, but only a few Gatewalkers have been able to master it, resulting in the use of the forgotten art of sword fighting based on focus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/515def6450aef9cb3580abc60c0c88c39de798c6.jpg[/img]

In other words, this technique consists of gaining focus points by hitting opponents with the sword. Obtaining an appropriate number of points strengthens the attacks with additional power (fully focused stance). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/d1e28b5e081c16cce53b8737b901db56306c0f41.jpg[/img]

Gatewalkers trained in this art never lose focus during a fight (adrenaline). Only after the end of the skirmish, during relaxation, do the points slowly drop to zero (1 point per 5 seconds). 

Let us show you what skills you will get if you choose a Greatsword during your expeditions:

[olist]
[*] [b]Greatsword Swing[/b] - a powerful two-handed blow that deals cone-shaped damage in front of you. This ability charges the focus points on the hit and deals additional damage in a fully focused stance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/0d83196c88d7ebedda1ad32d77d79d30265e080e.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Shielding Swing[/b] - is a mighty Greatsword strike, which, apart from long range, also makes you take a defensive stance. This stance strengthens your defense by adding a temporary shield. This ability charges the focus points on the hit and deals additional damage in a fully focused stance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/ddcd8fe877fe10acff441c3ed6b06b9538a18330.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Focus Implosion[/b] - you hit the ground with a Greatsword, consuming the aggregate energy of focus. As a result, it creates a powerful area of effect (AOE) that deals damage and stuns enemies. If the focus was fully charged, it makes the AOE hit performed three times. This significantly increases the AOE damage and extends the time of the stun. This skill also consumes all focus points on use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/ab514daf31a70b77eaf52eaed85515197fbfa51f.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]Piercing charge[/b] - the player stands in a charging pose and then runs straight ahead. It is a dash that passes through enemies and deals damage to everyone along the way. Useful for smashing the enemy, as well as to dodging quickly. It charges focus points on hits and deals additional damage in a fully focused stance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/f1b7505e31bfca81056c0eb7847d91a6843b5f27.jpg[/img]

[/olist]
We hope that you will like this classic weapon with a twist! Please let us know your thoughts in the comments! We value your feedback, so don’t hesitate to write :) You can do this by joining our Discord here:

[url=discord.gg/8Tn76pT][img]https://i.imgur.com/36gkSKj.gif[/img][/url]

Gatewalkers Dev Team

notes.title: Ancient Qubic
notes.content:
Dear Gatewalkers!

Today we want to introduce a new weapon - Ancient qubic! 

First, look at our concept art to see it in full detail. We find this weapon very cool, and we hope you will find it interesting too!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/340f15aed80d4685fe210af02b0b94454687319d.jpg[/img]

Ancient qubic is a technology used by the Ancients. The long-forgotten weapon was found and developed by Viktor. He learned how to bridle its power and steer it. Now Gatewalkers can creatively use it to fight. 


Basically, the technology consists of a giant glove, conjugated to the drone - a qubic. Gatewalker can steer the qubic using the glove. 


It has four skills. The first one - main skill - is a single shot. The qubic is aimed at the target, and then it applies the stack Qubic Curse. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/f8fcae46ab66eb44b8877b6da1864872fac79a92.jpg[/img]

Secondary skill is qubic detonation. The qubic hits the target and splits into many fragments forming a large cone of AOE damage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/b5727d69fbdab26e7daa173e6de79fdfcff3e49d.jpg[/img]

Third way to use this weapon is called Energy Whip. Skill creates a whip with a chain of philotic energy from qubicks. It reduces resistance by 10%, in the case of an element, an additional 20% for this element.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/c95963ab3d9f19ad34a7214a0b5f9dfb7bea85a5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/0f26bc434b8da310d25842974fb0878515e1d6d8.jpg[/img]

Last but not least, you can use the Ancient Link. 
After casting, the player links to opponents who have at least one Qubic Curse stack.

Opponent gets damage every second depending on the number of stacks and heals depending on that number. So, the more stacks, the bigger the damage!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/40e571fb0ba805d539f2b623ccab73ce4b7cdca7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/2441a0df7d48b1c601d9b62ffb0e7355db8a9eb5.jpg[/img]

We hope that you will like the new weapon! Please let us know your thoughts in the comments! We value your feedback, so don’t hesitate to write a word. You can do this by joining our Discord here:

This place is crucial for Gatewalkers - it hides powerful devices. However, to get them, the player will face multiple obstacles... Life can never be too simple for a Gatewalker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/9531decb7e8d3b915f588fb6991c42fe01e9448f.jpg[/img]

The Ancient Iron Mine is only an example of multiple facilities you will visit during your journey. Stay tuned for more information and extras. See you on the other side of the Gate!

notes.title: Gatewalkers weaponry #4 - Force Staff
notes.content:
Hi Gatewalkers!

Today we will introduce one of the basic weapons, the force staff! Some of you have already been playing with Force staff during the beta tests, but we made some tweaks especially for higher tiers (T4+). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/709421f3f5023d73d2f1f3f3166a12d77620d90d.png[/img]

[b]Overview[/b]: Force staff users can harness the essence of their surroundings by using the technology of the Ancients. Some Gatewalkers don't like using Ancient technology, which is not fully understood by The Guild yet. But for the more adventurous, a force staff can be a great weapon of choice. 

The force staff is a basic weapon usable from the start of the game. This ranged, two-handed weapon can deal massive damage from a distance. Moreover, force staffs are capable of immobilizing (aka rooting) enemies briefly. 

Now let us discuss force staff in detail.

[b]Ancient Curse[/b]: Every non-basic attack made with a force staff curses enemies. This curse deals damage and vanishes when the target is hit by a basic attack. This mechanic makes chaining your skills properly essential for maximizing your damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/29257d052a9c5ee479baebaf44bd2c3faf93380e.jpg[/img]

[b]Force Projectile[/b]: A projectile that hits a single target and can trigger additional damage from the ancient curse. More advanced force staffs can trigger ancient curses that explode, dealing damage to all targets in a small area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/eefd673d3722692a05153d59efa7dfacc8dc6231.jpg[/img]

[b]Force Grenade[/b]: A slow-flying grenade that deals damage and immobilizes briefly all targets in the impact area. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/0727618e2b74bcc2bbbc84053addf3d69faa0d60.jpg[/img]

[b]Force Nova[/b]: Skill that deals damage and immobilizes briefly all targets around the caster. It also increases the speed of the caster for a short time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/8ac28cbd0aa44171ac92b9c5e4826edc98eb4bc3.jpg[/img]

[b]Force Discharge[/b]: A powerful wave of energy flows from the staff forming an energy projectile. It travels slowly dealing damage to all targets on its path. For top-tier staffs, this projectile consumes additional energy from the surroundings on its way increasing its force while traveling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/c048f28f690652013a35f8176158f5db281b4b32.jpg[/img]

[b]Ancient curse buff[/b]: In addition to other benefits from higher-level weapons, after reaching T4 the ancient curse will give additional benefit to the force staff user. With each consecutive curse hit, the player will get a buff to damage dealt.


We hope that you will like the weapon and you will try it out! Please let us know your thoughts in the comments!

notes.title: Gatewalkers weaponry #3 - Spellsword
notes.content:
Hi Gatewalkers,

today we will introduce one of Gatewalker’s weaponry classics, the spellsword! The spellsword was already available in the beta tests, but we have tweaked some of its elemental and higher tier (T4+) versions. So even if some of you already wielded a spellsword, some of its mechanics have changed since then.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/c2fa01d475c9e38cc8ed0ade2a5d478e9aae9981.jpg[/img]

Spellswords, despite their appearance, are not cutting weapons. The core of the weapon is made using the technology of the Ancients. Gatewalkers interested in dealing medium-range, area attacks will find this weapon particularly interesting. Due to its shorter range, spellsword users have to stay closer to their targets than other magic weapon wielders. This inherent weakness is offset by a larger area of attack of its skills. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/bf62ec49089ef96da19e40f9f4ac5d9e7d478eee.jpg[/img]

[b]Sonic Wave[/b]: This simple attack is a wave of energy within a close-/medium-range. It hits every target in the area. Every once in a while, the spellsword charges itself. When it is charged, the next Sonic Wave will deal significantly more damage. Charged Sonic Waves will also have a larger area of attack when used with endgame spellswords.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/c4bd5ce554757220a8bcc192901f51d74e114f37.jpg[/img]

[b]Pillar[/b]: The caster gathers energy in a selected spot, and after a short delay, every target in the area will be struck by a pillar of raw power. This power will charge the next Sonic Wave if the caster chooses to be in the striking area of this skill. This secondary skill attack effect changes significantly with different elemental enchantments. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/493754e0c80fa2e7481f941a756e0b851a1aaeb9.jpg[/img]

The key to maximizing damage with a spell sword is charging Sonic Waves often. To achieve this goal, one must consistently hit both oneself and the enemies with pillar spells.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/cd3f85802e5bcd4a79976a450e2d297c720316d2.jpg[/img]

[b]Spell Surge[/b]: A massive high-damage vortex of energy forms around the caster. The vortex deals bursts of damage to all targets for a short period. This spell’s secondary effects are affected by the weapon’s element the same way as the pillar spell.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/52b641a9364b70e2ee0694c098d6443da06b2b73.jpg[/img]

[b]Elemental modifications[/b]: The pillar’s and spell surge’s skills secondary effects change depending on the element ingrained into the core of the spellsword. 
Those effects are:
[list]
[*] Heat: More damage to enemies and damage buff for friendly targets.
[*] Shock: Interrupts and dazes enemies. Faster movement for caster and his allies.
[*] Cold: Slows down and stuns enemies. 
[*] Void: Weakness debuff for enemies that decreases their attack power and resistance.
[*] Toxic: Toxic poison that deals damage to enemies over a period of time.
[/list]
Also, remember, this is a one-handed weapon, so you can use it in combination with all shields and off-hand weapons like pistols or torches.

We hope you will like the weapon and try it out! Please let us know your thoughts in the comments!

notes.content:
Dear Gatewalkers!

Today, we will present the concept of underground Ancient Facilities that you will explore during your expeditions on Fire Worlds. An example of such an Ancient Facility would be a device for collecting heat energy from lava and aggregating it into coil batteries. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/c70ad58a3058a87feeb66e9a96acc9246731b34c.jpg[/img]
[i]The entrance to the complex [/i]

As you can see, the underground complex combines the natural chambers of the cave with ancient platforms. This is possible because Deulitium alloy and other rare elements used by the ancients to build such complexes have very high resistance to heat. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/749cb3fa515fbcb1fb8e6ea2ebb195f857bad764.jpg[/img]
[i]The underground complex [/i]

The presented Ancient Facility consist of the following important places pointed on the above isometric view: 
[olist]
[*] The entry to the complex is usually a hatch that is hard to miss when you explore the unknown corners of the Fire World.
[*] Battery coils that aggregate the power extracted from heat.
[*] A heat power extractor that reaches far below the lava surface.
[*] Extractors are crucial and hazardous devices that can explode when their work is disrupted. Therefore, they are protected by ancient guardians.
[*] The final reward, the challenge box with the treasures of the Ancients.
[/olist]
The Facility presented today is just one example of multiple facilities you will discover during your journeys as a Gatewalker. We hope you will like them! Stay tuned and see you on the other side of The Gate!

notes.title: Gatewalkers weaponry #2 - Hatchet
notes.content:
Hi Gatewalkers,

today, we are presenting our second weaponry post. This time we will take a look at the Hatchet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/a05a466364afc314fb4ae5e62dfba801eace9628.jpg[/img]

The Hatchet is a simple but deadly weapon if used by the right person. It is a one-handed mid-range weapon as well as a melee weapon. The key mechanic of this weapon is based on two states: (1) throwing and (2) rage.    
The combat is initialized by throwing (default state), allowing the Player to poke an enemy from mid-range. Throws resulting in enemy hits stack the bleeding effect in this state, which increases the rage counter. At any time, the Player can use its ultimate ability to deal massive damage (based on the number of rage stacks on enemies) and change the state to Rage. Mid-range abilities change into melee combat spells that allow diving into close combat in the Rage state.

It is worth noticing that a hatchet is a one-handed damage-per-second (DPS) weapon, which means you can combine it with, for example, a handgun to further increase DPS or with a shield for a more defensive build.

Now let us look at skills available in the mid-range state:

[b]Axe Throw[/b]: Throw the ax straight, hitting the first enemy encountered. Additionally, it applies a bleed stack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/c9d7b8af477c7b5cde205197d5cd7028f7e89ddb.jpg[/img]

[b]Axe Boomerang Throw[/b]: A spinning ax throw to a distance of 6.5 meters. The ax passes through all the targets it hits, dealing damage and applying a bleeding effect. After reaching its maximum range, it returns to the thrower. If the Player catches the Hatchet on the way back, the cooldown is reduced by half.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/a9d0515f0da21183de3ad22b9871a298d32eeed8.jpg[/img]

[b]Bloody Rage[/b]: The Player goes berserk (Rage state) and consumes all bleed stacks in the area (13 meters range). Each stack consumed deals additional damage and increases the power of berserk.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/4b0ea8bc754e0848b12f72b18f66b8ba5b6edbc6.jpg[/img]

The more stacks a player consumes on casting a skill, the longer the berserk lasts and the more resilience they gain. During the berserk, the Axe Throw skill switches to Rage Axe Swing, and Axe Boomerang Throw switches Rage Slash. 
 
Skills available during Rage state:

[b]Rage Axe Swing[/b]: Very fast crosswise ax strike that deals a lot of damage. This skill has a low cooldown which allows you to use it almost continuously.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/cec6eee7f52afb8e7ba9ebf298c6e9d6f6df64ce.jpg[/img]

[b]Rage Slash[/b]: Slower but stronger ax strike against opponents in hand-to-hand combat. Additionally, each enemy hit extends the duration of the rage state. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/fc8e3bd2c3a67e0a05f8f73dfa97fcca65f3630c.jpg[/img]

That is all for today's weaponry post! Please let us know your thoughts in the comments!

notes.title: Gatewalkers weaponry #1 - Rifle
notes.content:
Hi Gatewalkers,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/ff189ed80f9a12575e28785247018b12e69646fa.jpg[/img]

Today we will introduce to you one of the new weapons that will be available during Gatewalkers’ release. The rifle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/b1f44e4304d372ad0046e43f8d4fd7f1b3f876ce.jpg[/img]

Rifles are technological innovations in the Guild, and not many Gatewalkers had a chance to use them. Innovative weapons created by guild engineers are often underestimated by Gatewalkers, who are more familiar with classic ranged weapons such as bows and crossbows.

But those we tried to use Rifles during their expeditions usually stick with them for a long time! 

The rifle is an advanced (T4+) slow-speed two-handed ranged weapon. Complex reloading mechanics make this weapon relatively slow, but massive damage dealt by even a single shot makes up for it. Now let us discuss each rifle spell in detail:

Single Shot: Projects o single shot with robust damage. It marks enemies with a "Sharp Shooter Mark.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/6a6114ff6a1fdfc9313fd4d3f1f34cb351d7ef06.jpg[/img]

Shrapnel Projectile: Guild rifles can be loaded with explosive projectiles. The projectiles hit the target and split into many fragments forming a large cone of AOE damage. In addition, the shooter can activate the projectile split at any time by re-casting it. This spell marks enemies with a "Sharp Shooter Mark.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/d2a9c7e529ce32f853e4f48c26715e9363189414.jpg[/img]

Rush Back Fire: This skill consists of two subsequent phases. In the first phase, the player sprints forward a long distance. During the sprint, the player's resistance raises significantly. In addition, all the enemies the player runs next to get marked with a "Sharp Shooter Mark.” 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/f953a3cb37b468154eb09bdce0ab6c9ca73250a4.jpg[/img]

In the second phase (second activation of this spell), the player shoots a splash projectile that deals massive damage to enemies marked with a "Sharp Shooter Mark.” Then, the player jumps back in the opposite direction to the shot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/bdac0be073e066b42fd0f330e6ca0f576b7b6e7f.jpg[/img]

Aimed Shots: The player kneels on one knee and aims with the rifle for a while. After aiming, the player shoots at the cursor position. After the first shot, it immediately goes to the second and then the third shots. You cannot move during shooting. Each shot deals great damage as it passes through all enemies. The damage is hugely increased if Aimed shots hit enemies with a "Sharp Shooter Mark.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/adb0318d33fe8e8bf5277b15f00266ebac7f331e.jpg[/img]

We hope that you will like the new weapon and you will try it out! Please let us know your thoughts in the comments!

notes.title: Fire Lavu
notes.content:
Hi Gatewalkers!

Fire Lavu are beings that live and breed in the dark depths of scorching hot magma lakes. They are the only species that adapted to such an extreme environment, which allows them freely grow their population without risking contact with other predators.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/d71e2207d35d3c6f1c65f5557c95f4cd27f1657d.jpg[/img]

Fire Lavu hunt on the surface, so you have to be extremely careful when traveling through Fire Worlds. Places to be especially on the lookout include river banks and reservoirs of molten lava. In these places, Fire Lavu jump out of the lava and attack unsuspecting victims.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/d05cd184177e0a61571097265541abfa7eb85662.jpg[/img]

When hunting, Fire Lavu can also be spotted roaming freely on the surface. During battles, they are bloody fast.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/be5e7846235a8c391dc992e0f5315615d1031c62.jpg[/img]

Their deadliest weapon is a highly condensed ray of heat that wreaks fiery havoc, turning everything and everyone in its way to ashes.
We hope you like this new enemy endemic to the Fire Worlds. Visit our discord to let us know what you think!

notes.title: Fireborns
notes.content:
Hi Gatewalkers! In the heart of Fire World, you can find mysterious humanoids. They are called Fireborn, but is that really their name? Nobody knows. In fact, we do not even know if they are an intelligent race or not. Some Gatewalkers report dwellings that look like Fireborn homes, but maybe it’s just fire world fumes messing with their heads? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/f5ba287606e6824b5762c2eaca010779bb3fe966.jpg[/img]

All we know for sure about Fireborns is that lava flows in their veins, and oily goo boils in their guts. As a result, they are extremely heat resistant, which allows them to live in a fire world, among rivers of lava, combusting geysers, and environmental anomalies such as meteor showers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/f5ba287606e6824b5762c2eaca010779bb3fe966.jpg[/img]

Fireborns have a strange ability to produce glands that look like bags and are filled with a flammable, explosive substance. When fighting with enemies, they use these glands as deadly weapons. In combat, they launch them into the air like projectiles. When they hit the target, they explode, dealing massive damage. Interestingly, the glands mentioned above grow back almost immediately, making Fireborns even more dangerous.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/146981397fe1ca93fad0001246e7ec9253d922a5.jpg[/img]

Finally, Fireborns have some strange connection to the anomaly. Apparently, when the anomaly strikes, they become restless and more aggressive. Moreover, their fire manipulation abilities become even more powerful than usual.

notes.title: The Spark, a mysterious rock creature.
notes.content:
Hi Gatewalkers,

as you know, we are now working on a new fire world that will be available in Gatewalkers on release. This is a harsh and unfriendly place, where Gatewalkers will face extreme temperatures, dangerous anomalies like fire tornados, magma gazers, and more. This dangerous environment leads to the evolution of very mysterious creatures. The first one of them that we will introduce today is called Spark. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/d981fa20abecefb7e8245e6d14af4c51a6636a43.jpg[/img]

Spark looks like a pack of magma rocks that orbit around the glowing and extremely hot core. It is not sure if this creature is a natural inhabitant of this world or a result of experiments performed by the Ancients. Nevertheless, only a short observation of Sparks shows that they behave like thinking beings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/eceb30cc605a6fb9dff98c56c8c1e7d5ca2476be.jpg[/img]

Sparks are small and quite common creatures inhabiting the Fire world. usually, they can be found in groups of two or three individuals. They do not pose a great threat if you face them solo, but in groups, they become a real challenge. Sparks developed a cooperative tactic to fight enemies by focusing the power of fire, used by them for defense, of multiple Sparks into a single Spark. Therefore this single Spark (boosted by allies) generates a high-energy projectile for the entire group. As a result, Sparks can fight with much larger and more powerful opponents and win such encounters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/fbff32a9fc956d28bbdd7313243126b27b7eaf8c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/6f4896e27fd8bf090508c231699707489ee245d0.jpg[/img]

Please let us know what you think about Spark on the #general channel of our discord. Best of luck and see you on the other side of The Gate!

notes.title: CREATURES IN FOREST DUNGEONS
notes.content:
Hello Gatewalkers,

As you know, Gatewalkers roam different worlds in search of valuable resources and secrets of the Ancients. Some of the more interesting places you’ll be able to explore during your expeditions are dungeons. Dungeons can be found, for example, in forest, toxic, and ice worlds. Today, we will show you some of the creatures you may encounter while exploring underground complexes found in forest worlds.

Before you start exploring a dungeon, you must find its entrance. The entrance can be hidden anywhere in a given world, so you must extra vigilant not to miss it. These modest, barely noticeable caverns can lead to surprisingly vast underground complexes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/fb1ae43c2da5e775adb851325c9a25b934756483.jpg[/img]

Once you find a dungeon entrance, you best get ready for a fierce fight with underground dwellers. It’s no coincidence that Monkey Bats or Hollows don’t live only on the surface and do not venture underground.

The creatures most commonly found in forest dungeons are Etchers, nimble beasts that release saprolings during battle. Saprolings are little critters that sacrifice their own lives to protect their symbiotic host. A released saproling charges towards its enemy and explodes, causing large-area damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/8456d4961ec93d02caea2b9ada0cda3fd43f4d52.jpg[/img]

Other creatures you might encounter are Rootmen, the evolved form of Etchers that live in symbiosis with plants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/7abc7a5254a59a689082839f393e15c346f6ef81.jpg[/img]

It is worth mentioning that in the darkest depths of dungeons, you can find even stranger creatures called Beremurs. Unfortunately, little is known about their origins or abilities. But who knows, maybe you will be one of the first Gatewalkers to face these cryptic creatures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/7fa3dcfea846ac967b86562b3886fe2be8188e6a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Probe mechanics
notes.content:
Hello Gatewalkers!
 
You have probably wondered how is it that the Guild has access to all those different worlds connected by the Ancient’s tunnel system. There are two ways to obtain coordinates, which work like an address you have to enter to open a tunnel to a new world. The first way is to get an exact address to a world and enter it manually at the Guild’s Portal. From time to time, you will also find coordinates during your expeditions. Such newly-found coordinates will let you travel to new places and accomplish missions (Quest worlds). The alternative way is to obtain coordinates using probes. 
 
Probes are devices invented by the Guild’s lead scientist, Victor. Victor created probes by combining information gathered from numerous fragments of Ancient machines. After countless hours spent studying the workings of Ancient machines, he learned how to use their powers. As a result, Victor developed recipes that use Ancient fragments and a handful of additional resources to create probes. Probes are very easy to use. You send a probe through the Portal to scan the tunnels linking different worlds. Once your probe finds a new world, it immediately sends the world’s coordinates back to the Portal’s console.
 
To create a probe, you have to visit Victor Hemming's Laboratory and choose a recipe.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/61ab6c79672a88336c245887a7511489da6f9026.jpg[/img]
 
After its created, you start the probe by selecting it in your inventory.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/a825c49f42091dbd4e89742c9d74269e29e474f3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/20711cd3dc23bca799d26cdd617efa0973337696.jpg[/img]

Then, the probe flies into the Portal and finds the coordinates of a new world.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/1e6ae987cd13b12d5971869605a65638738086fb.png[/img]
 
It is worth mentioning that probes are categorized into types and tiers. Depending on the chosen recipe, a probe will search for worlds of a specified type and tier; for example, a forest world with tier 6 resources or a Sky Rocks world with tier 5 resources. You must remember, however, that high-tier worlds mean not only better resources but also stronger enemies. The world with the best resources is not always the best choice!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/001879d2131bae72fb1d8457a5b453defd840c33.jpg[/img]
 
We hope that you will enjoy the presented mechanics of finding new worlds. Thank you for being with us, and keep following us for new Gatewalkers updates.
 
[url=discord.gg/8Tn76pT][img]https://i.imgur.com/DMVZpJO.gif[/img][/url]
(click on the banner above)


Best wishes,
Gatewalkers Dev Team

notes.title: The world in the sky!
notes.content:
Hello Gatewalkers!
 
Today, we are going to show another world that you will be able to explore while playing Gatewalkers. Members of the Guild call this world the Sky Rocks. A characteristic feature of this world is the lack of solid ground. Gravitational anomalies make have turned this world into a collection of pieces soil and rocks floating in the air like islands in a sea of clouds. No wonder that this world is the home of Volarians, a winged humanoid race capable of thriving in the skies. Volarians are a technologically advanced race. In addition to developing advanced weaponry, they have been able to master some of the machines of the Ancient. Advanced technology and Volarians’ impulsive nature are an explosive combo, so each Gatewalker should be especially cautious when travelling through the Sky Rocks.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/82248b63d5c111a8b820f5b1c9ea3a138ad7c70c.jpg[/img]
 
Volarians have created a hierarchical society with several settlements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/141efe60d6d8c4c782b537de0fcd249a156c9b57.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/ade70dd4ce0055db9ac633a935a3faa56ebcb306.jpg[/img]
 
Sky Rocks are also inhabited by plant turtles, which grow valuable resources on their shells. Other creatures, called Drerguu, are bred by Volarians for food.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/ef74908cecfdb74e28da513cb35ca5329dba9582.jpg[/img]

Apart from aggressive inhabitants, Sky Rocks are a dangerous place because of weather anomalies. Dynamic actions (such as combat) done during exploration, cause electrical charge to accumulate in living organisms. If that electrical charge surpasses a critical level, a deadly electrostatic discharge may occur.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/88b45e6217d13ecdaa141b3938d87b00557ca65a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/590d8a92ab9edd0c0169d79def7a3fb623d1c3dc.jpg[/img]

To defend Gatewalkers from electrical discharges, Victor (the Guild’s scientist) has developed lightning rods. Lightning rods are devices that you put on the ground close to an organism with a high level of electrical charge. The device forces an electrostatic discharge that hits the rod instead of a human being. Lightning rods can save lives as well as help decrease levels of electrical charge.
 
[url=discord.gg/8Tn76pT][img]https://i.imgur.com/DMVZpJO.gif[/img][/url]
(click on the banner above)

Best regards
Gatewalkers DevTeam

notes.title: Trading in the Guild
notes.content:
Hello Gatewalkers!
 
Today, we wanted to show you a new in-game mechanic we’ve been working on recently. Meet Mikael, the Guild merchant…
 
Mikael is not formally a Guild member but is entitled to trade goods between the Guild and the outer world. This means that the Guild gets all the goods necessary to operate and trades treasures gathered during expeditions in return.
 
In practice, Mikael buys anything that is of any value and comes from foreign worlds. Sometimes, these are figurines crafted by Surians (forest dwellers), and at other times these are mysterious toxic flowers found in the crevasses of toxic worlds. These and other exotic items are highly valued by the inhabitants of the Guild’s home planet. That is why trade is the main source of income for Gatewalkers.
 
Of course, trading works both ways. Gatewalkers not only sell their treasures but also buy all sorts of goods. For example, Mikael can offer flour needed to prepare various combat-buffing meals in Luis’ kitchen or rare mutagenic minerals (see our last post about the Transmutator).
 
You will find Mikael in the main hall of the Guild. Just start talking to him to get trading.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/d866f6b0cfbbe816aa3c77c7794b05a971e85f2b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/f4967c425f808868bb9fd292809a396211e3919b.jpg[/img]
 
Apart from creating a typical in-game shop (buying and selling), we did not forget about the players’ QoL. One of the first things we thought of was adding the possibility of canceling accidental transactions with Mikael. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/17f63f0557d457fd4409600502a3ce5303ec042e.png[/img]
 
Another enhancement we believe will make playing easier is the possibility of trading directly from the player’s storage.
 
We do hope you will enjoy trading with Mikael! Please let us know what you think, and see you on the other side of the gate!

notes.title: Transmutation
notes.content:
While exploring different worlds in Gatewalkers, players gather various resources, such as wood, metal, or fiber. Back at the Guild, these resources can be used to create improved items, which increase the chances of surviving in even more dangerous worlds. As a result, players craft enhanced armors and high-damage dealing weapons like grenade launchers or soaked-in-magic elemental staffs. Regardless of the path the player takes, with time, some resources gathered during previous expeditions will not be needed. To make it possible to still use these unneeded resources, we have created the transmutation mechanism. For example, when all you need to craft your dream sword is one T6 ingot of metal, you can transmute lower-tier metals. To perform transmutation, the player has to use a mysterious device, called the Transmutator, which can be found in the Guild.
 
The Transmutator is located in Victor’s lab:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/8bdd77b254fd416af4afe26e4314b18d71ee50d6.jpg[/img]

After activating the Transmutator, the player can transform crafting materials into other (higher or lower tier) crafting materials as needed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35523866/2d25f08aaaad8b1ee0ae9bde91631eb6d8244d30.jpg[/img]
 
An additional ingredient is needed for the transmutation to take place, the Transmutation Reagent. Below are example recipes for obtaining resources of higher and lower tiers:
● 	T4 resource + 30x Transmutation Reagent -> T5 resource
● 	T5 resource +   4x Transmutation Reagent -> T4 resource
 
Players can buy the Transmutation Reagent from the Guild’s merchant. The merchant runs a shop with various useful items, but more on that in our next dev-post!

Please let us know what do you think about the transmutator feature and join our discrod (click on the  banner below)!
